subject.title: fix(auto-reply): decide no-visible-reply fallback from settled delivery via a turn ledger

question: Should a successful automatic-mode message-tool delivery to the originating Discord thread count as visible source delivery and suppress the parent-channel fallback?
rationale: The code must distinguish source-related thread replies from arbitrary cross-target message-tool side effects; that routing contract affects when OpenClaw suppresses a recovery message.

options.title: Treat source-related thread replies as visible
options.body: Record only verified source-channel or source-thread messaging-tool targets as observed delivery, and add regression coverage for both matching and unrelated targets.

options.title: Keep current fallback semantics
options.body: Continue treating automatic-mode message-tool sends as independent side effects, accepting that a delivered thread answer can be followed by the parent fallback.

options.title: Narrow this PR to known ledger corners
options.body: Land only after removing the all-lanes claim and track the route-aware message-tool handoff as a separate canonical bug.

recommendation.title: Treat source-related thread replies as visible
recommendation.body: Record only verified source-channel or source-thread messaging-tool targets as observed delivery, and add regression coverage for both matching and unrelated targets.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete live reproduction and the route/intent boundary that the decision must preserve.
